fact: For the real endpoints a=inf B−η/2 and b=sup B+η/2, the interval J=Set.Ioo a b is open in the usual topology of ℝ.

grounds.reason: M016 and M017, after the displayed boundedness proof, supply real endpoints inf B and sup B.
J is defined to be the open interval with those endpoints; η is real, so both endpoints are real.
η is introduced as a real parameter.

justification: The probed declaration isOpen_Ioo requires a topological space, linear order and OrderClosedTopology, with no endpoint ordering premise. At α=ℝ the ordinary real order and topology satisfy these conditions: pinned Mathlib/Topology/MetricSpace/Pseudo/Lemmas.lean:23–25 supplies OrderTopology ℝ, and Mathlib/Topology/Order/Basic.lean:404–417 supplies OrderTopology.to_orderClosedTopology. Mathlib/Topology/Order/OrderClosed.lean:582–599 matches the full probed statement. This is a routine topological property of the already constructed interval, not a replacement of the core supremum/infimum proof.
hint: Apply isOpen_Ioo with α := ℝ to the displayed endpoints.
